note: v607: low-heat mode (Jesuye, Galaxy Z Fold heating in multiwindow). One shared scheduler (assets/lowheat.js, loaded first): after 60 s without a touch, key or scroll, or when the window loses focus, the news ticker, the /story/ drift, painting and 1 s settle, and the mini story card spin stop; other frames drop to about 10 fps and fast UI timers to every 10 s. While in use, frames are capped at about 30 fps (full rate while a finger is down). Data polls run every 2-5 min (story drawing every 3 min), the version check every 5 min. Hidden tabs pause everything except audio and saving, then refresh once on return. Slideshow, live GIF frames, tweet embeds and saved settings are unchanged. ?lowheat=0 turns it off for a wall projector.
